name: Casa Anita
desc: The restaurant serves fresh sea-food of the day, no menu. Due to small space you will be seated with other guests at a large table in the small dining room.

desc: One of the rare places where you can eat full meals between 16:00 and 20:30, when most cafes are closed. Gaspatzo and pizza are good; fish is not.

desc: Serves local cuisine in a cute hidden street. It has not many places outside, hence reservation recommended.

name: Can Rafa
desc: Owned and run by the Martin Faixo family, it offers fresh sea-food and a recommended paella.

name: El Gato
desc: The restaurant serves reasonably priced special food. Be patient for the service.
